stem: Which of the following statement about T cell and graft versus host disease(GVHD) is incorrect?

options.A: Acute GVHD may be caused by activation of donor CD8 and CD4+ T cell which is driven initially by recipient antigen presenting cells.
options.B: The frequency of T cells that respond to any given Minor histocompatibility antigens has be estimated at 0.01%-0.10%
